author: Kai Moreno
title: Invoice PDF regeneration
content:
# Purpose
How to resend or regenerate an invoice PDF when the customer says the file is blank or the VAT line is missing.

# When to use
How to resend or regenerate an invoice PDF when the customer says the file is blank or the VAT line is missing.

# What Support does
P4, Billing Ops via Support. Do not issue a credit because a PDF is blank. Regenerate first. Credits stay forbidden on the Support API.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
P4, Billing Ops via Support. Do not issue a credit because a PDF is blank. Regenerate first. Credits stay forbidden on the Support API. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
